steps.caption: Jump Game II: think in ranges. With 0 jumps you can stand on index 0. Scan the range and track the farthest index reachable from it.
End of the range reachable with 0 jump(s). Everything up to index 2 is reachable with 1. That's the next range.
End of the range reachable with 1 jump(s). Everything up to index 4 is reachable with 2. That's the next range.
End of the range reachable with 2 jump(s). Everything up to index 8 is reachable with 3. That's the next range.
The last index is inside range #3: minimum 3 jumps. It's BFS over indexes without a queue: O(n), O(1) space.
